entities.title: No path restriction
entities.summary: afs reads any path the user running it may read, absolute or relative to its working directory.
entities.impact: An agent given afs can read every file the user can, including outside the project; only the operating system's permissions limit it.
entities.workaround: Run afs as a user, or in a sandbox, that can read only what the agent should see.

entities.title: Memory lasts one process
entities.summary: Unchanged markers, diffs, cached results and indexes exist only within one `afs serve` or `afs jsonl` process; `afs call` has none.
entities.impact: A restarted server, or each `afs call`, sends everything in full again and rebuilds its caches.
entities.workaround: Keep one `afs serve` or `afs jsonl` process for the whole session.

entities.title: Search reports at most one match per line, on the line where it starts
entities.summary: Patterns are matched across the whole file buffer in multi-line mode; each match is reported on the line where it starts, and the scan then resumes at the next line.
entities.impact: A second match on the same line is neither shown nor counted, so total_matches counts matching lines; a match spanning lines is shown only by its first line.

entities.title: Binary means a NUL in the first 8000 bytes
entities.summary: A file is treated as binary only when its first 8000 bytes hold a NUL byte.
entities.impact: Binary files are not read as lines, searched or outlined; UTF-16 text counts as binary, and a binary file without an early NUL is treated as text.

entities.title: Unix only
entities.summary: The code uses Unix file metadata (std::os::unix), so it builds only on Unix-like systems; batched loading exists only on Linux and macOS.
entities.impact: No Windows build. On other Unix systems every file is read one at a time.

entities.title: Session tables are cleared, not trimmed
entities.summary: The result cache (256 entries), the stamp and sent tables (200,000 entries) and the index table (8 configurations) are emptied whole when they reach their limit.
entities.impact: In a very long or very broad session, a repeat right after a clear is answered in full and recomputed rather than with an unchanged marker or a cache hit.
